primary.method: paired percentile bootstrap of questions, retaining both seed outcomes together
primary.scope: conditional on these two continuation checkpoints; shared initial model; no training-seed uncertainty

decision.evidence_scope: Positive held-out answer-accuracy increment of the frozen recovery-state/suffix training recipe under this 5000-training-question KQA Pro setup; two conditional continuation seeds sharing an initial model

reason: The preregistered mean gain is +4.75 percentage points with question-bootstrap 95% interval [3.525, 5.975625]; both matched seed estimates and intervals are positive. Retain the method, stop public-benchmark tuning, and move to radar knowledge verification and domain application.
limits: This project holdout is not the official hidden test and cannot rule out backbone pretraining exposure.
Two continuation seeds share the initial model and corpus; intervals condition on the checkpoints and resample 2000 questions, not 4000 independent records.
Answer matching does not establish preservation of all semantic conditions. Detailed-error masking did not establish a reliable diagnostic-text mechanism.
Supervised token budgets match but input/compute budgets differ. The comparison identifies the whole recovery-context/handle-remapping/suffix recipe.
C uses approximately 24 times P total inference tokens; higher quality is not a claim of lower overall deployment cost or faster inference.
Subgroup estimates are descriptive, overlapping and not multiplicity-adjusted; no selective subgroup success claim.
next_steps: Write the public benchmark method/results chapter using both continuation seeds, cost comparisons, and the bounded mechanism findings.
Advance the 12-item radar fact review and source corrections; independent human acceptance remains separate from AI prescreening.
Implement the minimal radar query/source/condition adapter and validate a complete source-to-fact-to-answer example before any new domain training.
Freeze independent radar QA and same-source baselines after verified facts are ready; existing automatic QA is not independent gold.
